intent_en: To illustrate the severe shortage of medical oxygen caused by a massive surge in daily demand during the pandemic, which forced industries to redirect supplies.
previous_intent: To illustrate the dramatic surge in estimated daily medical oxygen demand in early 2021 and the resulting supply crisis that forced industries to redirect their resources to hospitals.
narration_support: To meet the rising demand for medical oxygen, nearly all industries redirected their supply to hospitals.
chart_support: Line chart showing estimated daily oxygen needed in cubic meters from March 2020 to April 2021, revealing a dramatic spike in early 2021.
evidence_note: The narration explains the consequences of the oxygen shortage (lives lost, industry redirection) while the chart visualizes the magnitude of the demand surge, specifically the sharp increase in early 2021.
